user.title: Utility portal account
user.description: Sign in with the account you use on the web portal of your utility. The login form is detected automatically; only fill in the advanced fields if that fails.

data_description.base_url: For customers of Regio Energie Solothurn: https://okp.regioenergie.ch
data_description.username: On okp.regioenergie.ch this is the e-mail address you sign in with.
data_description.login_url: Full address of the login page, if it is not found automatically.
data_description.username_field: Name of the username input in the login form.
data_description.password_field: Name of the password input in the login form.

meter_type.title: What does the meter measure?
meter_type.description: The unit and the prices on the next screen follow from this. Electricity and water are tested; gas and district heating are not - please report back if they work for you.

meter_details.title: Add meter
meter_details.description:
Prices are optional and are given in {currency} per {unit}. Enter one and the integration imports a second statistic with the costs, which the energy dashboard accepts as "a statistic tracking total costs".

Regio Energie bills electricity at a lower rate from April to September and a higher one from October to March - enter both. For water enter only the first price, and add the water and the wastewater price together to get the real price per m³.

data_description.name: Used for the statistic name, e.g. Electricity or Water.
data_description.meter_number: Listed in the portal under Lastgang, on okp.regioenergie.ch at /de/services/lastgang.php.
data_description.unit: Must match the unit the portal exports.
data_description.obis_code: Leave at 1-1:1.29.0 unless the portal uses a different code.
data_description.export_type: Leave at WirkBezug unless the portal uses a different one.
data_description.price: Applies all year unless a winter price is set.
data_description.price_winter: Leave empty if the price is the same all year.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored credentials for {username}.

error.cannot_connect: The portal could not be reached.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected these credentials, or the login form could not be found. Fill in the advanced login fields to point the integration at the right form.
error.no_data: The portal returned no readings for this meter. Check the meter number, the OBIS code and the export type.
error.invalid_unit: This unit does not fit the selected meter type.
error.price_required: A winter price needs a base price as well.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
